verdict.rationale: The Bolna CLI explicitly manages "batches" (bolna-docs-16, bolna-docs-24), which points to bulk call operations over many contacts. API-driven outreach workflows (bolna-docs-12) and the claim of thousands of calls per minute (bolna-docs-22) suggest high-volume automation, but none of the evidence describes how batches work or any bulk actions on other items. Missing for 10: documentation of batch creation/upload semantics, bulk operations on agents/numbers/executions (e.g., bulk update/delete), batch support via API/MCP, and hands-on corroboration.
